literal_meaning: চলা এবং চলমান অবস্থা (movement and ongoing motion)
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজ বৃষ্টির কারণে চলাচল বিঘ্নিত হয়েছে।
শহরে চলাচলের জন্য মেট্রো ট্রেন সবচেয়ে ভালো।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to rain today, the commute has been disrupted.
The metro train is the best for traffic in the city.
note: This term is commonly used in urban contexts to refer to vehicular or pedestrian movement, often in news or daily conversations about disruptions.
